LocaleResource.Name: IndentCategoryFilters.Hint

LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether to display suggestions with similar terms for the entered search phrase under "Did you mean" or "Related search terms".

LocaleResource.Name: MaxIndexedSuggestions.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the maximum number of indexed suggestions. 0 means that all suggestions are indexed.

LocaleResource.Name: SpellCheckerMaxSuggestions.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the maximum number of displayed suggestions.

LocaleResource.Name: SpellCheckerMinQueryLength.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the minimum length of a search term. For shorter terms no suggestions will be provided.

LocaleResource.Name: SpellCheckerMaxHitCount.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the maximum number of product hits up to which suggestions are provided.

LocaleResource.Name: SpellCheckerRelatedTerms.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether or not to display related search terms in a successful search.

LocaleResource.Name: IsTopCategoriesActive.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether to display suggestions for categories for the entered search phrase.

LocaleResource.Name: MaxTopCategories.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the maximum number of category suggestions.

LocaleResource.Name: IsTopManufacturersActive.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether to display suggestions for manufacturers/brands for the entered search phrase.

LocaleResource.Name: MaxTopManufacturers.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the maximum number of manufacturer/brand suggestions.

LocaleResource.Name: DefaultAnalysis.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies which text analysis to use. "Automatic (language specific processing)" is recommended. For some fields, such as SKU and Product Tag, an analysis appropriate to that field is predefined. This setting is only effective for the catalog index. The forum index is always processed language specifically.

LocaleResource.Name: MinTermLength.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the minimum length of words to be considered (so called terms). "2" is the recommended value. Words with a shorter length are ignored. An increased value drastically reduces the number of search hits.

LocaleResource.Name: IsAdvancedTextAnalysisActive.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether to enable the advanced text analysis.

LocaleResource.Name: TextAnalysisType.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Allows you to specify a different text analysis for the product name (catalog index), as well as the subject and post text (forum index).

LocaleResource.Name: Abbreviations.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies abbreviations (like inch, oz) to get more search hits. Search phrases with and without space characters will be found.

LocaleResource.Name: Synonyms.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Allows specification of synonym groups. Enter all words of one group in one row separated by comma. Example: notebook,laptop,convertible.

LocaleResource.Name: SplitterCustomWords.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: You can add custom words to the standard dictionary. The dictionary is necessary in order to be able to split compound words meaningfully so that all subwords are found. Enter one word per line.

LocaleResource.Name: SplitterExceptionWords.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies compound words to be excluded from splitting. Enter one word per line. Use the pipe character | to mark the correct place to split the word, example Techniker|kranken|kasse.

LocaleResource.Name: EnableBoost.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Enables or disables boost of certain search fields.
